metadata.description: Reclaim Protocol tools for Claude Code. Verify data points about your users — followers, balances, orders — by finding, building, testing, and fixing the data verification providers that do the verifying.

plugins.name: reclaim
plugins.description: Build and maintain Reclaim Protocol data verification providers from your editor: capture a site's network traffic, synthesize a provider recipe, replay it, run a zkTLS proof, and publish it. Also inspects verification sessions and diagnoses failed ones. Use when verifying a data point about a user — a follower count, an account balance, an order history. Bundles the Reclaim MCP server, whose how_it_works tool serves the authoring guide one topic at a time.
